content: Hinteno, kawotethato, shiiqidi si7ite! Hinteno, asaw akeekite! Biittaynne biittan de7iyaba ubbay, sa7inne sa7ape keyaaba ubbay si7o.
Goday kawotethata ubbaa bolla hanqetis; enta tooranchota ubbaa bolla yilotis. I, enta ubbaa dhaysana; enta shukeysatas aathidi immana.
Enta ahay holetidi, attidi xinqana; dereti enta suuthan kametana.
Salo xoolintoti ubbay seerana; saloti saleenada xaaxetana. Woyne haythinne balase ayfey qoqofeteysada xoolintoti ubbay qoqofetana.
Ta mashshay salotan alana gakanaw uyis; Heko Edoome bolla, taani dhaysida asaa bolla pirdanaw wodhana.

Godaa mashshay suuthan muuketis. Yarshos shuketiya dorsatanne deeshata suuthan mashshi muuketeysadanne enta kilaho modhuwan kameteysada Godaa mashshay suuthan muuketis; modhuwan kametis. Goday Baasora kataman yarsho, Edoome biittan gita shuka giigisis.
Menthati, wofaanotinne boorati entara kundana. Enta gadey suutha xalaala gidana; enta biittay modhon munuqetana.
Goday halo keyana gallasinne Xiyoone olida morketa bolla kushe zaariya laythi giigisis.
Edoome shaafati melidi made gidis; iya baanay diinne laametana; iya biittay eexiya made gidana.
Qammanne gallas tamay to77enna; iya cuyay merinaw cuyana. Edoome biittay yeletethaafe yeletethaa gakanaw baysa gidana; oonika merinaw yaara kanthenna.
Shin xiloynne quxarey iya laattana; guttoynne quuroy yan daana. Xoossay Edoome bolla laaletha wadha wodoronne baysatetha tumbe yeddana.
He biitta aysiya kawoy deenna; halaqati yaape kichana.
Kawo keethata agunthi, miixata ohi ma7ana; workanati allatiya bessinne yanchoti de7iya soo gidana.
Bazzo do7ati godaretara gahetana; tuna ayyaanati issoy issuwara xeegetana; qamma qoolleti wodhidi yan daana.
Guttoti yan keethe keexidi, phuuphullidi qoxana. Banta nayta banta qefeta garsan haphana; phircoti banta laggetara yan shiiqana.
Godaa maxaafan koyidi nabbabite. Godaa doonay odida gishonne iya ayyaanay shiishida gisho, haysatape issoyka pacenna; qassi issoyka ba laggey bayna deenna.
I, entaw saama kessis; iya kushey biitta entaw wodoron shaakis; enti iya merinaw laattana; yeletethaafe yeletethaa gakanaw enti yan daana.
